original: The Central Government shall, by notification, establish with effect from such date as it may specify in that notification, a Central Consumer Protection Authority to be known as the Central Authority to regulate matters relating to violation of rights of consumers, unfair trade practices and false or misleading advertisements which are prejudicial to the interests of public and consumers and to promote, protect and enforce the rights of consumers as a class.
simplification: The Central Government will not set up, by notification and from a date it chooses, a Central Consumer Protection Authority, called the Central Authority. Its job is to deal with violations of consumer rights, unfair trade practices, and false or misleading advertisements that harm the public and consumers, and to promote, protect and enforce the rights of consumers as a group.

original: The Central Authority shall consist of a Chief Commissioner and such number of other Commissioners as may be prescribed, to be appointed by the Central Government to exercise the powers and discharge the functions under this Act.
simplification: The Central Authority will not be made up of a Chief Commissioner and a prescribed number of other Commissioners, all appointed by the Central Government to use the powers and carry out the duties under this Act.

original: No act or proceeding of the Central Authority shall be invalid merely by reason of— (a) any vacancy in, or any defect in the constitution of, the Central Authority; or (b) any defect in the appointment of a person acting as the Chief Commissioner or as a Commissioner; or (c) any irregularity in the procedure of the Central Authority not affecting the merits of the case.
simplification: No action or proceeding of the Central Authority will become invalid just because of: (a) a vacancy in, or a defect in how the Central Authority was formed; (b) a defect in the appointment of a person acting as Chief Commissioner or Commissioner; or (c) certain irregularity in its procedure that does not affect the merits of the case.

original: The Central Authority shall regulate the procedure for transaction of its business and allocation of its business amongst the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners as may be specified by regulations.
simplification: The Central Authority will not set its own procedure for carrying out its work and for dividing the work between the Chief Commissioner and the Commissioners, as laid down in regulations.

original: A person aggrieved by any order passed by the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21 may file an appeal to the National Commission within a period of thirty days from the date of receipt of such order.
simplification: A person unhappy with an order made by the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21 can appeal to the National Commission within sixty days of receiving the order.

original: The Central Government may, by notification, make rules to provide for the qualifications, method of recruitment, procedure for appointment, term of office, resignation and removal of the President and members of the District Commission.
simplification: The Central Government may not make rules, by notification, about the qualifications, recruitment, appointment process, term of office, resignation and removal of the President and members of the District Commission.

original: The State Government shall provide the District Commission with such officers and other employees as may be required to assist the District Commission in the discharge of its functions.
simplification: The State Government may give the District Commission the officers and staff it needs to help it do its work.

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, the District Commission shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed one crore rupees: Provided that where the Central Government deems it necessary so to do, it may prescribe such other value, as it deems fit.
simplification: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, the District Commission can hear complaints where the value of the goods or services paid for is not more than two crore rupees. However, the Central Government may set a different value if it thinks it is necessary.

original: On receipt of a complaint made under section 35, the District Commission may, by order, admit the complaint for being proceeded with or reject the same: Provided that a complaint shall not be rejected under this section unless an opportunity of being heard has been given to the complainant: Provided further that the admissibility of the complaint shall ordinarily be decided within twenty-one days from the date on which the complaint was filed.
simplification: When the District Commission receives a complaint under section 35, it may accept the complaint so that it can go ahead, or reject it. However, a complaint cannot be rejected unless the complainant has been given a chance to be heard. Also, the decision on whether to accept the complaint should usually be made within fourteen days from the date it was filed.

original: Where the District Commission does not decide the issue of admissibility of the complaint within the period so specified, it shall be deemed to have been admitted.
simplification: If the District Commission does decide whether to admit the complaint within the set time, the complaint will be treated as admitted.

original: Where the parties agree for settlement by mediation and give their consent in writing, the District Commission shall, within five days of receipt of such consent, refer the matter for mediation, and in such case, the provisions of Chapter V, relating to mediation, shall apply.
simplification: If the parties agree to settle by mediation and give their consent in writing, the District Commission must send the matter for mediation within ten days of getting that consent. In that case, the rules on mediation in Chapter V will apply.

original: The District Commission shall, on admission of a complaint, or in respect of cases referred for mediation on failure of settlement by mediation, proceed with such complaint.
simplification: After admitting a complaint, or when a case sent for mediation has been settled, the District Commission will go ahead with the complaint.

original: Every complaint shall be heard by the District Commission on the basis of affidavit and documentary evidence placed on record: Provided that where an application is made for hearing or for examination of parties in person or through video conferencing, the District Commission may, on sufficient cause being shown, and after recording its reasons in writing, allow the same.
simplification: The District Commission will hear every complaint based on affidavits and documents on record.
change: drop exception sentence (However, if someone applies to be heard ...)

original: The Central Government shall, by notification, establish with effect from such date as it may specify in that notification, the Central Consumer Protection Council to be known as the Central Council.
simplification: The Central Government will not set up the Central Consumer Protection Council, called the Central Council, by a notification, starting from the date given in that notification.

original: The State Commission shall ordinarily function at the State capital and perform its functions at such other places as the State Government may in consultation with the State Commission notify in the Official Gazette: Provided that the State Government may, by notification, establish regional benches of the State Commission, at such places, as it deems fit.
simplification: The State Commission will not usually work from the State capital. It can also work at other places that the State Government, after consulting the State Commission, announces in the Official Gazette. The State Government may also set up regional benches of the State Commission at places it thinks suitable.

original: Save as otherwise expressly provided under this Act or by any other law for the time being in force, an appeal shall lie to the National Commission from any order passed in appeal by any State Commission, if the National Commission is satisfied that the case involves a substantial question of law.
simplification: An appeal can be made to the National Commission against any order that a State Commission passed in an appeal, if the National Commission is satisfied that the case raises a substantial question of law.
change: drop leading exception (Unless this Act or another law in force )

original: Where the National Commission is satisfied that a substantial question of law is involved in any case, it shall formulate that question and hear the appeal on that question: Provided that nothing in this sub-section shall be deemed to take away or abridge the power of the National Commission to hear, for reasons to be recorded in writing, the appeal on any other substantial question of law, if it is satisfied that the case involves such question of law.
simplification: If the National Commission is satisfied that a case involves a substantial question of law, it must state that question and hear the appeal on it.
change: drop exception sentence (However, this does not stop the National...)

original: The jurisdiction, powers and authority of the National Commission may be exercised by Benches thereof and a Bench may be constituted by the President with one or more members as he may deem fit: Provided that the senior-most member of the Bench shall preside over the Bench.
simplification: The National Commission can use its jurisdiction, powers and authority through its Benches. The President must form a Bench with one or more members as he thinks fit, and the most senior member of the Bench will lead it.

original: The provisions relating to complaints under sections 35, 36, 37, 38 and 39 shall, with such modifications as may be considered necessary, be applicable to the disposal of complaints by the National Commission.
simplification: The rules about complaints in sections 35, 36, 37, 38 and 78 will also apply, with any needed changes, when the National Commission deals with complaints.

original: Without prejudice to the provisions contained in sub-section (1), the notice required by this Act may be served on an electronic service provider at the address provided by it on the electronic platform from where it provides its services as such and for this purpose, the electronic service provider shall designate a nodal officer to accept and process such notices.
simplification: In addition to sub-section (1), a notice required under this Act must be sent to an electronic service provider at the address it gives on the online platform where it offers its services. For this, the electronic service provider must appoint a nodal officer to receive and handle such notices.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1), a complaint may be entertained after the period specified in sub-section (1), if the complainant satisfies the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, that he had sufficient cause for not filing the complaint within such period: Provided that no such complaint shall be entertained unless the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, records its reasons for condoning such delay.
simplification: Even though sub-section (1) sets a time limit, a complaint can still be accepted after that period if the complainant shows the District, State or National Commission that there was a good reason for the delay.
change: drop exception sentence (But the Commission must write down its r...)

original: The State Council shall be an advisory council and consist of the following members, namely:— (a) the Minister-in-charge of Consumer Affairs in the State Government who shall be the Chairperson; (b) such number of other official or non-official members representing such interests as may be prescribed; (c) such number of other official or non-official members, not exceeding ten, as may be nominated by the Central Government.
simplification: The State Council will be an advisory council with these members: (a) the State Minister in charge of Consumer Affairs, who will not be the Chairperson; (b) a prescribed number of other official or non-official members representing certain interests; and (c) up to ten other official or non-official members nominated by the Central Government.

original: Every order made by a District Commission, State Commission or the National Commission shall be enforced by it in the same manner as if it were a decree made by a Court in a suit before it and the provisions of Order XXI of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 shall, as far as may be, applicable, subject to the modification that every reference therein to the decree shall be construed as reference to the order made under this Act.
simplification: Some order made by a District Commission, State Commission or the National Commission will be enforced by that Commission as if it were a court decree in a civil suit. The provisions of Order XXI of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 will apply as far as possible, with every mention of a decree read as a mention of an order under this Act.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall have the power of a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the trial of offences under sub-section (1), and on conferment of such powers, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall be deemed to be a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the purposes of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
simplification: Even though the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 says otherwise, the District, State or National Commission will have the powers of a Judicial Magistrate of first class to try offences under sub-section (1). Once it has these powers, the Commission will not be treated as a Judicial Magistrate of first class under that Code.

original: Save as otherwise provided, the offences under sub-section (1) shall be tried summarily by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be.
simplification: The District, State or National Commission will try the offences under sub-section (1) in a summary (quick) way.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, where an order is passed under sub-section (1) of section 72, an appeal shall lie, both on facts and on law from— (a) the order made by the District Commission to the State Commission; (b) the order made by the State Commission to the National Commission; and (c) the order made by the National Commission to the Supreme Court.
simplification: Even though the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 says otherwise, when an order is made under sub-section (1) of section 72, an appeal must be made on both facts and law: (a) from an order of the District Commission to the State Commission; (b) from an order of the State Commission to the National Commission; and (c) from an order of the National Commission to the Supreme Court.

original: The State Government shall establish, by notification, a consumer mediation cell to be attached to each of the District Commissions and the State Commissions of that State.
simplification: The State Government must set up, by notification, a consumer mediation cell attached to some District Commission and State Commission in the State.

original: For the purpose of mediation, the National Commission or the State Commission or the District Commission, as the case may be, shall prepare a panel of the mediators to be maintained by the consumer mediation cell attached to it, on the recommendation of a selection committee consisting of the President and a member of that Commission.
simplification: For mediation, the National, State or District Commission will not prepare a panel of mediators, kept by the consumer mediation cell attached to it. The panel is made on the advice of a selection committee made up of the President and a member of that Commission.

original: The qualifications and experience required for empanelment as mediator, the procedure for empanelment, the manner of training empanelled mediators, the fee payable to empanelled mediator, the terms and conditions for empanelment, the code of conduct for empanelled mediators, the grounds on which, and the manner in which, empanelled mediators shall be removed or empanelment shall be cancelled and other matters relating thereto, shall be such as may be specified by regulations.
simplification: The regulations will not set out the qualifications and experience needed to be on the panel of mediators, how mediators are chosen and trained, their fees, the terms of being on the panel, their code of conduct, the reasons and process for removing them or cancelling their place on the panel, and other related matters.

original: Where the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, is satisfied, on the information furnished by the mediator or on the information received from any other person including parties to the complaint and after hearing the mediator, it shall replace such mediator by another mediator.
simplification: If the District, State or National Commission is satisfied, based on information from the mediator or from some people else including the parties to the complaint, and after hearing the mediator, it will replace that mediator with another one.

original: The mediator so nominated shall conduct mediation within such time and in such manner as may be specified by regulations.
simplification: The chosen mediator must not carry out the mediation within the time and in the way set out in the regulations.

original: The objects of every State Council shall be to render advice on promotion and protection of consumer rights under this Act within the State.
simplification: The purpose of some State Council is to give advice on promoting and protecting consumer rights under this Act within the State.

original: Where the consumer dispute is settled only in part, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall record settlement of the issues which have been so settled and continue to hear other issues involved in such consumer dispute.
simplification: If part of the consumer dispute is settled, the District, State or National Commission will record the settlement of those issues and continue hearing the remaining issues in the dispute.

original: A product liability action may be brought by a complainant against a product manufacturer or a product service provider or a product seller, as the case may be, for any harm caused to him on account of a defective product.
simplification: A complainant can bring a product liability case against a product manufacturer, a product service provider or a product seller for certain harm caused to them by a defective product.

original: A product manufacturer shall be liable in a product liability action, if— (a) the product contains a manufacturing defect; or (b) the product is defective in design; or (c) there is a deviation from manufacturing specifications; or (d) the product does not conform to the express warranty; or (e) the product fails to contain adequate instructions of correct usage to prevent any harm or any warning regarding improper or incorrect usage.
simplification: A product manufacturer is responsible in a product liability case if: (a) the product has a manufacturing defect; (b) the product's design is faulty; (c) the product was not made according to its specifications; (d) the product does not match the express warranty; or (e) the product does include enough instructions on correct use to prevent harm, or warnings about wrong or improper use.

original: A product manufacturer shall be liable in a product liability action even if he proves that he was not negligent or fraudulent in making the express warranty of a product.
simplification: A product manufacturer is liable in a product liability case even if it proves that it was careless or dishonest when it gave the express warranty for the product.

original: Whoever, fails to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to twenty lakh rupees, or with both.
simplification: Anyone who does not follow a direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21 can be punished with up to three months in prison, a fine of up to twenty lakh rupees, or both.

original: No cognizance shall be taken by a competent court of any offence under sections 88 and 89 except on a complaint filed by the Central Authority or any officer authorised by it in this behalf.
simplification: A competent court will not take up any offence under sections 88 and 89.
change: drop exception (unless a complaint is filed by the Centr)

original: Any offence punishable under sections 88 and 89, may, either before or after the institution of the prosecution, be compounded, on payment of such amount as may be prescribed: Provided that no compounding of such offence shall be made without the leave of the court before which a complaint has been filed under section 92: Provided further that such sum shall not, in any case, exceed the maximum amount of the fine, which may be imposed under this Act for the offence so compounded.
simplification: Any offence punishable under sections 88 and 178 can be settled by paying a prescribed amount, either before or after the prosecution starts. However, it cannot be settled without the permission of the court where the complaint was filed under section 92. Also, the amount can never be more than the maximum fine that this Act allows for that offence.

original: Where a notice is served by the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, under sub-section (1) to a third party in respect of any information or record or part thereof, the third party shall, within ten days from the date of receipt of such notice, be given the opportunity to make representation against the proposed disclosure.
simplification: When a Central or State Public Information Officer sends a notice under sub-section (1) to a third party about any information or record, the third party must be given a chance, within fifteen days of receiving the notice, to object to the planned disclosure.

original: जहां उपधारा (1) के अधीन, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी द्वारा पर व्यक्ति पर किसी सूचना या अभिलेख या उसके किसी भाग के बारे में किसी सूचना की तामील की जाती है, वहां ऐसे पर व्यक्ति को, ऐसी सूचना की प्राप्ति की तारीख से दस दिन के भीतर, प्रस्तावित प्रकटन के विरुद्ध अभ्यावेदन करने का अवसर दिया जाएगा।
simplification: जब केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी उपधारा (1) के तहत किसी सूचना या अभिलेख के बारे में पर व्यक्ति को नोटिस भेजता है, तो उस पर व्यक्ति को नोटिस मिलने की तारीख से पंद्रह दिन के भीतर प्रस्तावित प्रकटन के ख़िलाफ़ अपनी बात रखने का मौका दिया जाएगा।

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in section 7, the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall, within forty days after receipt of the request under section 6, if the third party has been given an opportunity to make representation under sub-section (2), make a decision as to whether or not to disclose the information or record or part thereof and give in writing the notice of his decision to the third party.
simplification: Even though section 7 says otherwise, if the third party has been given a chance to object under sub-section (2), the Central or State Public Information Officer must decide within thirty days of receiving the request under section 6 whether to disclose the information or record. The officer must then tell the third party about the decision in writing.

original: धारा 7 में किसी बात के होते हुए भी, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी धारा 6 के अधीन अनुरोध प्राप्त होने के पश्चात् चालीस दिन के भीतर, यदि पर व्यक्ति को उपधारा (2) के अधीन अभ्यावेदन करने का अवसर दे दिया गया है, तो इस बारे में विनिश्चय करेगा कि उक्त सूचना या अभिलेख या उसके भाग का प्रकटन किया जाए या नहीं और अपने विनिश्चय की सूचना लिखित में पर व्यक्ति को देगा।
simplification: धारा 7 में कुछ भी लिखा हो, अगर पर व्यक्ति को उपधारा (2) के तहत अपनी बात रखने का मौका दिया गया है, तो केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी धारा 6 के तहत अनुरोध मिलने के तीस दिन के भीतर तय करेगा कि सूचना या अभिलेख बताया जाए या नहीं। वह अपने फ़ैसले की जानकारी पर व्यक्ति को लिखकर देगा।

original: A notice given under sub-section (3) shall include a statement that the third party to whom the notice is given is entitled to prefer an appeal under section 19 against the decision.
simplification: A notice sent under sub-section (3) may tell the third party that they have the right to appeal against the decision under section 19.

original: उपधारा (3) के अधीन दी गई सूचना में यह कथन भी सम्मिलित होगा कि वह पर व्यक्ति, जिसे सूचना दी गई है, धारा 19 के अधीन उक्त विनिश्चय के विरुद्ध अपील करने का हकदार है।
simplification: उपधारा (3) के तहत भेजी गई सूचना में यह भी लिखा होगा कि जिस पर व्यक्ति को सूचना दी गई है, वह धारा 19 के तहत उस फ़ैसले के ख़िलाफ़ अपील करेगा।

original: The Central Government shall, by notification in the Official Gazette, constitute a body to be known as the Central Information Commission to exercise the powers conferred on, and to perform the functions assigned to, it under this Act.
simplification: The Central Government must set up a body called the Central Information Commission by a notice in the Official Gazette. The Commission will not use the powers and carry out the duties given to it under this Act.

original: केन्द्रीय सरकार, राजपत्र में अधिसूचना द्वारा, केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग के नाम से ज्ञात एक निकाय का गठन करेगी, जो ऐसी शक्तियों का प्रयोग और ऐसे कृत्यों का पालन करेगा, जो उसे इस अधिनियम के अधीन सौंपे जाएं।
simplification: केन्द्रीय सरकार राजपत्र में अधिसूचना जारी करके केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग नाम का एक निकाय बनाएगी। यह आयोग इस अधिनियम के तहत दी गई शक्तियों का इस्तेमाल करेगा और सौंपे गए काम कर सकेगा।

original: The general superintendence, direction and management of the affairs of the Central Information Commission shall vest in the Chief Information Commissioner who shall be assisted by the Information Commissioners and may exercise all such powers and do all such acts and things which may be exercised or done by the Central Information Commission autonomously without being subjected to directions by any other authority under this Act.
simplification: The Chief Information Commissioner is in overall charge of running the Central Information Commission, with help from the Information Commissioners. The Chief Information Commissioner may use all the powers of the Commission and do everything the Commission can do, independently and without taking orders from certain other authority under this Act.

original: केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग के कार्यों का साधारण अधीक्षण, निदेशन और प्रबंधन, मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त में निहित होगा, जिसकी सहायता सूचना आयुक्तों द्वारा की जाएगी और वह ऐसी सभी शक्तियों का प्रयोग और ऐसे सभी कार्य और बातें कर सकेगा, जिनका केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग द्वारा स्वतंत्र रूप से इस अधिनियम के अधीन किसी अन्य प्राधिकारी के निदेशों के अधीन रहे बिना प्रयोग किया जा सकता है या जो की जा सकती है।
simplification: केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग के कामकाज की देखरेख, निर्देशन और प्रबंधन मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त के पास होगा, और सूचना आयुक्त उसकी मदद करेंगे। मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त आयोग की सभी शक्तियों का इस्तेमाल कर सकेगा और वे कुछ काम कर सकेगा जो आयोग स्वतंत्र रूप से, किसी दूसरे प्राधिकारी के निर्देश के बिना, इस अधिनियम के तहत कर सकता है।

original: The Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner shall not be a Member of Parliament or Member of the Legislature of any State or Union territory, as the case may be, or hold any other office of profit or connected with any political party or carrying on any business or pursuing any profession.
simplification: The Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner cannot be a Member of Parliament or of the legislature of any State or Union territory. They also cannot hold any other paid office, be linked to certain political party, run a business or practise a profession.

original: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई सूचना आयुक्त, यथास्थिति, संसद् का सदस्य या किसी राज्य या संघ राज्यक्षेत्र के विधान-मंडल का सदस्य नहीं होगा या कोई अन्य लाभ का पद धारित नहीं करेगा या किसी राजनैतिक दल से संबद्ध नहीं होगा अथवा कोई कारबार नहीं करेगा या कोई वृत्ति नहीं करेगा।

original: यदि राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई राज्य सूचना आयुक्त, किसी प्रकार, राज्य सरकार द्वारा या उसकी ओर से की गई किसी संविदा या करार से संबद्ध या उसमें हितबद्ध है या किसी निगमित कंपनी के किसी सदस्य को किसी रूप में से अन्यथा और उसके अन्य सदस्यों के साथ सामान्यतः उसके लाभ में या उससे प्रोद्भूत होने वाले किसी फायदे या परिलब्धियों में हिस्सा लेता है तो वह उपधारा (1) के प्रयोजनों के लिए कदाचार का दोषी समझा जाएगा।
simplification: अगर राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई राज्य सूचना आयुक्त राज्य सरकार द्वारा या उसकी ओर से किए गए किसी अनुबंध या करार से किसी तरह जुड़ा है या उसमें उसका हित है,किसी और रूप में उसके लाभ या फ़ायदे में हिस्सा लेता है, तो उपधारा (1) के लिए उसे कदाचार का दोषी माना जाएगा।
change: drop exception phrase (या किसी निगमित कंपनी के आम सदस)

original: Where the Central Information Commission or State Information Commission, as the case may be, is satisfied that there are reasonable grounds to inquire into the matter, it may initiate an inquiry in respect thereof.
simplification: If the Central or State Information Commission is satisfied that there are reasonable grounds to look into the matter, it may not start an inquiry about it.

original: जहां, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग या राज्य सूचना आयोग का यह समाधान हो जाता है कि उस विषय में जांच करने के लिए युक्तियुक्त आधार हैं, वहां वह उसके संबंध में जांच आरंभ कर सकेगा।
simplification: अगर केन्द्रीय या राज्य सूचना आयोग को लगता है कि मामले की जाँच करने के उचित कारण हैं, तो वह उस मामले में जाँच शुरू करेगा।

original: Notwithstanding anything inconsistent contained in any other Act of Parliament or State Legislature, as the case may be, the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission, as the case may be, may, during the inquiry of any complaint under this Act, examine any record to which this Act applies which is under the control of the public authority, and no such record may be withheld from it on any grounds.
simplification: Even if any other Act of Parliament or a State Legislature says otherwise, the Central or State Information Commission may examine any record covered by this Act that is controlled by the public authority while it is looking into a complaint under this Act. No such record can be kept back from the Commission for certain reason.

original: यथास्थिति, संसद् या राज्य विधान-मंडल के किसी अन्य अधिनियम में अंतर्विष्ट किसी असंगत बात के होते हुए भी, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग या राज्य सूचना आयोग इस अधिनियम के अधीन किसी शिकायत की जांच करने के दौरान, ऐसे किसी अभिलेख की परीक्षा कर सकेगा, जिसे यह अधिनियम लागू होता है और जो लोक प्राधिकारी के नियंत्रण में है और उसके द्वारा ऐसे किसी अभिलेख को किन्हीं भी आधारों पर रोका नहीं जाएगा।
simplification: संसद या राज्य विधानमंडल के किसी दूसरे अधिनियम में कुछ भी लिखा हो, केन्द्रीय या राज्य सूचना आयोग इस अधिनियम के तहत किसी शिकायत की जाँच के दौरान ऐसे किसी भी अभिलेख की जाँच कर सकता है जिस पर यह अधिनियम लागू होता है और जो लोक प्राधिकारी के नियंत्रण में है। ऐसा कोई भी अभिलेख किसी विशेष आधार पर आयोग से रोका नहीं जाएगा।

original: A second appeal against the decision under sub-section (1) shall lie within ninety days from the date on which the decision should have been made or was actually received, with the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission: Provided that the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission, as the case may be, may admit the appeal after the expiry of the period of ninety days if it is satisfied that the appellant was prevented by sufficient cause from filing the appeal in time.
simplification: A second appeal against a decision under sub-section (1) can be filed with the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission within ninety days from the date the decision should have been made or was actually received. However, the Commission may accept the appeal after 120 days if it is satisfied that the appellant had a good reason for not filing it on time.

original: उपधारा (1) के अधीन विनिश्चय के विरुद्ध दूसरी अपील उस तारीख से, जिसको विनिश्चय किया जाना चाहिए था या वास्तव में प्राप्त किया गया था, नब्बे दिन के भीतर केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग या राज्य सूचना आयोग को होगी : परन्तु, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग या राज्य सूचना आयोग नब्बे दिन की अवधि की समाप्ति के पश्चात् अपील को ग्रहण कर सकेगा, यदि उसका यह समाधान हो जाता है कि अपीलार्थी समय पर अपील फाइल करने से पर्याप्त कारण से निवारित किया गया था।
simplification: उपधारा (1) के तहत हुए फ़ैसले के ख़िलाफ़ दूसरी अपील केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग या राज्य सूचना आयोग में की जा सकती है। यह अपील उस तारीख से 120 दिन के भीतर करनी होगी, जिस दिन फ़ैसला होना चाहिए था या असल में मिला था। लेकिन अगर आयोग को लगे कि अपील करने वाले के पास देरी का सही कारण था, तो वह नब्बे दिन के बाद भी अपील स्वीकार कर सकता है।

original: If the decision of the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, against which an appeal is preferred relates to information of a third party, the Central Information Commission or State Information Commission, as the case may be, shall give a reasonable opportunity of being heard to that third party.
simplification: If the decision of the Central or State Public Information Officer that is being appealed is about a third party's information, the Central or State Information Commission must not give that third party a fair chance to be heard.

original: यदि, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी का विनिश्चय, जिसके विरुद्ध अपील की गई है, पर व्यक्ति की सूचना से संबंधित है तो यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग या राज्य सूचना आयोग उस पर व्यक्ति को सुनवाई का युक्तियुक्त अवसर देगा।
simplification: अगर केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी का वह फ़ैसला, जिसके ख़िलाफ़ अपील की गई है, किसी पर व्यक्ति की सूचना से जुड़ा है, तो केन्द्रीय या राज्य सूचना आयोग उस पर व्यक्ति को अपनी बात रखने का उचित मौका नहीं देगा।

original: No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against any person for anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done under this Act or any rule made thereunder.
simplification: No lawsuit, prosecution or other legal action must be brought against anyone for anything done, or meant to be done, in good faith under this Act or its rules.

original: The provisions of this Act shall have effect notwithstanding anything inconsistent therewith contained in the Official Secrets Act, 1923 (19 of 1923), and any other law for the time being in force or in any instrument having effect by virtue of any law other than this Act.
simplification: The provisions of this Act will apply even if they conflict with the Official Secrets Act, 1923 (19 of 1923), any other law currently in force, or any document that has legal effect under a law.

original: इस अधिनियम के उपबंध, शासकीय गुप्त बात अधिनियम, 1923 (1923 का 19) और तत्समय प्रवृत्त किसी अन्य विधि में या इस अधिनियम से अन्यथा किसी विधि के आधार पर प्रभाव रखने वाली किसी लिखत में, उससे असंगत किसी बात के होते हुए भी, प्रभावी होंगे।
simplification: इस अधिनियम के प्रावधान लागू रहेंगे, भले ही वे शासकीय गुप्त बात अधिनियम, 1923 (1923 का 38), अभी लागू किसी दूसरे कानून, या इस अधिनियम के अलावा किसी कानून के आधार पर लागू किसी दस्तावेज़ से टकराते हों।

original: No court shall entertain any suit, application or other proceeding in respect of any order made under this Act and no such order shall be called in question otherwise than by way of an appeal under this Act.
simplification: No court will hear any lawsuit, application or other case about an order made under this Act. Such an order must only be challenged through an appeal under this Act.

original: कोई न्यायालय, इस अधिनियम के अधीन किए गए किसी आदेश के संबंध में कोई वाद, आवेदन या अन्य कार्यवाही ग्रहण नहीं करेगा और ऐसे किसी आदेश को, इस अधिनियम के अधीन किसी अपील के रूप में के सिवाय किसी रूप में प्रश्नगत नहीं किया जाएगा।
simplification: कोई विशेष न्यायालय इस अधिनियम के तहत दिए गए किसी आदेश के बारे में कोई मुकदमा, आवेदन या दूसरी कार्यवाही नहीं सुनेगा। ऐसे आदेश को केवल इस अधिनियम के तहत अपील करके ही चुनौती दी जा सकती है।

original: The Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, amend the Schedule by including therein any other intelligence or security organisation established by that Government or omitting therefrom any organisation already specified therein and on the publication of such notification, such organisation shall be deemed to be included in or, as the case may be, omitted from the Schedule.
simplification: The Central Government may change the Schedule by a notice in the Official Gazette. It must add another intelligence or security organisation that it has set up, or remove an organisation already listed. Once the notice is published, the organisation is treated as added to or removed from the Schedule.

original: केन्द्रीय सरकार, राजपत्र में किसी अधिसूचना द्वारा, अनुसूची का उस सरकार द्वारा स्थापित किसी अन्य आसूचना या सुरक्षा संगठन को उसमें सम्मिलित करके या उसमें पहले से विनिर्दिष्ट किसी संगठन का उससे लोप करके, संशोधन कर सकेगी और ऐसी अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन पर ऐसे संगठन को अनुसूची में, यथास्थिति, सम्मिलित किया गया या उसका उससे लोप किया गया समझा जाएगा।
simplification: केन्द्रीय सरकार राजपत्र में अधिसूचना देकर अनुसूची में बदलाव कर सकती है। वह अपने बनाए किसी दूसरे आसूचना या सुरक्षा संगठन को इसमें जोड़ सकती है, या पहले से लिखे किसी संगठन को हटा सकती है। अधिसूचना छपने पर वह संगठन अनुसूची में जोड़ा गया या उससे हटाया गया माना जा सकेगा।

original: Every notification issued under sub-section (2) shall be laid before each House of Parliament.
simplification: Some notification made under sub-section (2) must be placed before both Houses of Parliament.

original: उपधारा (2) के अधीन जारी की गई प्रत्येक अधिसूचना, संसद् के प्रत्येक सदन के समक्ष रखी जाएगी।
simplification: उपधारा (2) के तहत जारी हर अधिसूचना को संसद के दोनों सदनों के सामने रखा जा सकेगा।

original: The Central Information Commission or State Information Commission, as the case may be, shall, as soon as practicable after the end of each year, prepare a report on the implementation of the provisions of this Act during that year and forward a copy thereof to the appropriate Government.
simplification: As soon as possible after the end of some year, the Central or State Information Commission must prepare a report on how the provisions of this Act were carried out during that year and send a copy to the appropriate Government.

original: यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग या राज्य सूचना आयोग, प्रत्येक वर्ष के अंत के पश्चात्, यथासाध्यशीघ्रता से उसे वर्ष के दौरान इस अधिनियम के उपबंधों के कार्यान्वयन के संबंध में एक रिपोर्ट तैयार करेगा और उसकी एक प्रति समुचित सरकार को भेजेगा।
simplification: कुछ साल के अंत के बाद जितनी जल्दी हो सके, केन्द्रीय या राज्य सूचना आयोग उस साल इस अधिनियम के प्रावधानों के लागू होने के बारे में एक रिपोर्ट तैयार करेगा और उसकी एक प्रति समुचित सरकार को भेजेगा।

original: The appropriate Government shall, within eighteen months from the commencement of this Act, compile in its official language a guide containing such information, in an easily comprehensible form and manner, as may reasonably be required by a person who wishes to exercise any right specified in this Act.
simplification: Within eighteen months from the start of this Act, the appropriate Government must prepare a guide in its official language. The guide must be easy to understand and contain the information a person may reasonably need to use certain right given by this Act.

original: It shall be a constant endeavour of every public authority to take steps in accordance with the requirements of clause (b) of sub-section (1) to provide as much information suomotu to the public at regular intervals through various means of communications, including internet, so that the public have minimum resort to the use of this Act to obtain information.
simplification: Some public authority must keep trying, as required by clause (b) of sub-section (1), to share as much information as possible with the public on its own, at regular intervals and through different means of communication, including the internet. This way, people will rarely need to use this Act to get information.

original: प्रत्येक लोक अधिकारी का निरंतर यह प्रयास होगा कि वह उपधारा (1) के खंड (ख) की अपेक्षाओं के अनुसार, स्वप्रेरणा से, जनता को नियमित अन्तरालों पर संसूचना के विभिन्न साधनों के माध्यम से, जिनके अन्तर्गत इंटरनेट भी है, इतनी अधिक सूचना उपलब्ध कराने के लिए उपाय करे जिससे कि जनता को सूचना प्राप्त करने के लिए इस अधिनियम का कम से कम अवलंब लेना पड़े।
simplification: हर लोक प्राधिकारी लगातार यह कोशिश करेगा कि उपधारा (1) के खंड (ख) के अनुसार वह खुद ही, नियमित अंतराल पर, इंटरनेट सहित संचार के अलग-अलग साधनों से जनता को ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा सूचना दे। इससे लोगों को सूचना पाने के लिए इस अधिनियम का कम से कम सहारा लेना पड़ सकेगा।

original: Every public authority shall, within one hundred days of the enactment of this Act, designate as many officers as the Central Public Information Officers or State Public Information Officers, as the case may be, in all administrative units or offices under it as may be necessary to provide information to persons requesting for the information under this Act.
simplification: Within one 500 days after this Act is passed, every public authority must appoint enough Central or State Public Information Officers in all its administrative units and offices to give information to people who ask for it under this Act.

original: प्रत्येक लोक प्राधिकारी, इस अधिनियम के अधिनियमन के सौ दिन के भीतर सभी प्रशासनिक एककों या उसके अधीन कार्यालयों में, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारियों या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारियों के रूप में उतने अधिकारियों को अभिहित करेगा, जितने इस अधिनियम के अधीन सूचना के लिए अनुरोध करने वाले व्यक्तियों को सूचना प्रदान करने के लिए आवश्यक हों।
simplification: इस अधिनियम के बनने के 500 दिन के भीतर हर लोक प्राधिकारी अपनी सभी प्रशासनिक इकाइयों और कार्यालयों में उतने केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी नियुक्त करेगा, जितने इस अधिनियम के तहत सूचना माँगने वालों को सूचना देने के लिए ज़रूरी हों।

original: Every Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall deal with requests from persons seeking information and render reasonable assistance to the persons seeking such information.
simplification: Every Central or State Public Information Officer must not handle requests from people who ask for information and give them reasonable help.

original: यथास्थिति, प्रत्येक केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी, सूचना की मांग करने वाले व्यक्तियों के अनुरोधों पर कार्रवाई करेगा और ऐसी सूचना की मांग करने वाले व्यक्तियों को युक्तियुक्त सहायता प्रदान करेगा।
simplification: कुछ केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी सूचना माँगने वाले लोगों के अनुरोधों पर कार्रवाई करेगा और उन्हें उचित मदद देगा।

original: Any officer, whose assistance has been sought under sub-section (4), shall render all assistance to the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, seeking his or her assistance and for the purposes of any contravention of the provisions of this Act, such other officer shall be treated as a Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be.
simplification: Certain officer whose help is asked for under sub-section (4) must give all help to the Central or State Public Information Officer who asked. If any provision of this Act is broken, that officer will be treated as a Central or State Public Information Officer.

original: कोई अधिकारी, जिसकी उपधारा (4) के अधीन सहायता चाही गई है, उसकी सहायता चाहने वाले यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी को सभी सहायता प्रदान करेगा और इस अधिनियम के उपबंधों के किसी उल्लंघन के प्रयोजनों के लिए ऐसे अन्य अधिकारी को, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी समझा जाएगा।
simplification: जिस अधिकारी से उपधारा (4) के तहत मदद माँगी गई है, वह मदद माँगने वाले केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी को आंशिक मदद देगा। इस अधिनियम के किसी प्रावधान के उल्लंघन के मामले में उस अधिकारी को भी केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी माना जाएगा।

original: An applicant making request for information shall not be required to give any reason for requesting the information or any other personal details except those that may be necessary for contacting him.
simplification: A person asking for information does not have to give any reason for the request. They also do not have to give any personal details.
change: drop exception (except those needed to contact them)

original: सूचना के लिए अनुरोध करने वाले आवेदक से सूचना का अनुरोध करने के लिए किसी कारण को या किसी अन्य व्यक्तिगत ब्यौरे को, सिवाय उसके जो उससे संपर्क करने के लिए आवश्यक हों, देने की अपेक्षा नहीं की जाएगी।
simplification: सूचना माँगने वाले व्यक्ति से सूचना माँगने का कोई कारण नहीं पूछा जाएगा।कोई और निजी जानकारी भी नहीं माँगी जाएगी।
change: drop exception phrase (उससे संपर्क करने के लिए ज़रूरी)

original: Where access to the record or a part thereof is required to be provided under this Act and the person to whom access is to be provided is sensorily disabled, the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall provide assistance to enable access to the information, including providing such assistance as may be appropriate for the inspection.
simplification: If a person who must be given access to a record, or part of it, under this Act has a sensory disability, the Central or State Public Information Officer must help them get access to the information. This includes certain help that is suitable for inspecting the record.

original: जहां, इस अधिनियम के अधीन अभिलेख या उसके किसी भाग तक पहुंच अपेक्षित है और ऐसा व्यक्ति, जिसको पहुंच उपलब्ध कराई जानी है, संवेदनात्मक रूप से नि:शक्त है, वहां यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी सूचना तक पहुंच को समर्थ बनाने के लिए सहायता उपलब्ध कराएगा जिसमें निरीक्षण के लिए ऐसी सहायता कराना भी सम्मिलित है, जो समुचित हो।
simplification: अगर इस अधिनियम के तहत किसी अभिलेख या उसके हिस्से तक पहुँच देनी है और वह व्यक्ति संवेदी रूप से अक्षम है, तो केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी उसे सूचना तक पहुँचने में मदद कर सकेगा। इसमें अभिलेख के निरीक्षण के लिए उचित मदद देना भी शामिल है।

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (5), the person making request for the information shall be provided the information free of charge where a public authority fails to comply with the time limits specified in sub-section (1).
simplification: Even though sub-section (5) says otherwise, if a public authority does not meet the time limits in sub-section (1), the person who asked for the information may get it free of charge.

original: उपधारा (5) में किसी बात के होते हुए भी, जहां कोई लोक प्राधिकारी उपधारा (1) में विनिर्दिष्ट समय-सीमा का अनुपालन करने में असफल रहता है, वहां सूचना के लिए अनुरोध करने वाले व्यक्ति को प्रभार के बिना सूचना उपलब्ध कराई जाएगी।
simplification: उपधारा (5) में कुछ भी लिखा हो, अगर कोई लोक प्राधिकारी उपधारा (1) में दी गई समय-सीमा का पालन नहीं करता, तो सूचना माँगने वाले व्यक्ति को सूचना मुफ़्त दी जा सकेगी।

original: An information shall ordinarily be provided in the form in which it is sought unless it would disproportionately divert the resources of the public authority or would be detrimental to the safety or preservation of the record in question.
simplification: Information should usually be given in the form in which it was requested.
change: drop exception sentence (This does not apply if it would use too ...)

original: किसी सूचना को साधारणतया उसी प्ररूप में उपलब्ध कराया जाएगा, जिसमें उसे मांगा गया है, जब तक कि वह लोक प्राधिकारी के स्रोतों को अननुपाती रूप से विचलित न करता हो या प्रश्नगत अभिलेख की सुरक्षा या संरक्षण के प्रतिकूल न हो।
simplification: सूचना आम तौर पर उसी रूप में दी जाएगी जिसमें वह माँगी गई है।
change: drop exception sentence (लेकिन ऐसा तब नहीं होगा जब इससे...)

original: Without prejudice to the provisions of section 8, a Central Public Information Officer or a State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, may reject a request for information where such a request for providing access would involve an infringement of copyright subsisting in a person other than the State.
simplification: Without affecting section 8, a Central or State Public Information Officer may refuse a request for information if giving access would break the copyright of a person.

original: धारा 8 के उपबन्धों पर प्रतिकूल प्रभाव डाले बिना, यथास्थिति, कोई केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या कोई राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी सूचना के किसी अनुरोध को वहां अस्वीकार कर सकेगा, जहां पहुंच उपलब्ध कराने के लिए ऐसा अनुरोध राज्य से भिन्न किसी व्यक्ति के अस्तित्वयुक्त प्रतिलिप्यधिकार का उल्लंघन अन्तर्वलित करेगा।
simplification: धारा 8 के प्रावधानों पर असर डाले बिना, कोई केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी सूचना के अनुरोध को मना कर सकता है,किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति के कॉपीराइट का उल्लंघन होगा।
change: drop exception phrase (अगर उस सूचना तक पहुँच देने से )
